decision: The ticket was closed (event-027) although the completion claim is unverified and several closing checks were never met: no quote was approved, no invoice has been received, no appointment was ever confirmed with the tenant, and the landlord confirmation flagged at event-024 was never obtained. I took the reversible steps inside my mandate — chased the provider for the invoice, attendance date and photos (ACT-1), asked the tenant whether anyone attended and whether the lock now works (ACT-2), told the landlord that no amount is approved and no invoice is on file (ACT-3), and logged the discrepancies (ACT-4). Reopening a closed request, accepting an invoice for work carried out without the required prior approval, and deciding who bears that cost are human decisions (RTE-STAFF, APR-SPEND-OVER-CAP), so the case goes to the property manager.
